title: Working while travelling the world – B1 English Listening Test

seo.title: Working while travelling the world – B1 English Listening Test - Test-English
seo.description: Boost your listening skills with this B1 test on working while travelling. Answer questions, then check the transcript to learn new words.

parts:
B1 English Listening Test

Listen to three people talking about their experience working while travelling the world, and for questions 1 to 6, choose the correct answer.

See the full list of B1 listening tests
Questions

questions.prompt: Which of these things is most important to Tom?
Which is true about Tom's work routine?

choices.html: He sometimes works in the evenings.
He is not very organised and often works different hours.
He works from different types of places.

questions.prompt: Which of these words better describes Alex's job?
What does Alex think about his future?

choices.html: He doesn't want to work 12 hours a day forever.
He'd like to keep his job and have a family.
He'd like to quit his job and have children someday.

questions.prompt: Where does Emma mainly sell her art?
What is most important to Emma when choosing a destination?

choices.html: It should be affordable and interesting.
There should be lots of local artists.
